title: Codex experimental generated-schema provenance (Task 13 Protocol Truth)
whySeparateFromStable: The stable surface intentionally omits experimental fields. `thread/start.dynamicTools` and `initialize.params.capabilities.experimentalApi` only appear with --experimental, per the official v0.153.4 app-server README.
notes: These files carry ONLY the experimental shapes the Router depends on; the full experimental tree is reproducible with the generationCommand.
Field names/casing are taken from the generated artifacts, never from prose.
DynamicToolCallParams.required includes callId/threadId/tool/turnId: a missing callId is a protocol violation.
